summary: Workflow archive must use the CLI's known sync resources, and workflow status must inspect existing archives through the read-only store path.
reason: An empty archive resource list silently reports a successful zero-item archive even though the CLI has syncable resources. Status is a read-only inspection command and must not create, migrate, or lock a SQLite store when the user only asks whether archived data exists.
validated_outcome: Unit coverage verifies archive resource selection is non-empty and status does not create a missing database.
